caption: The drawing depicts a lidded sugar bowl with two large, symmetrical handles on either side. The bowl is ornate, featuring decorative bands with floral and circular patterns around its upper section. It stands on a pedestal base supported by four small round feet. The lid has a decorative finial at the top, and the body of the sugar bowl is rounded and reflective, with various highlights and shadows rendered in pencil. The drawing is created using pencil on a light, beige-toned paper, and is enclosed within a simple rectangular border. To the right of the sugar bowl, there is handwritten text reading "SUGAR BOWL about 7 x 7," followed by "Anna Weng L4 Silver Gallery" in smaller script. The drawing emphasizes detailed lines and shading to illustrate the metallic nature and intricate design of the sugar bowl. On the right edge, there is an additional vertical handwritten inscription.
title: Silver Sugar Bowl
